Class BoardViewController

java.lang.Object
view.board.BoardViewController
All Implemented Interfaces:
SceneController, ViewController
public class BoardViewController extends Object implements SceneController
Main in-game scene controller. Owns the status bar and end-of-game routing; delegates the play area and self-panel to sub-controllers injected via fx:include.
